contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.text: If you need help building or improving a web project, have a collaboration idea, or just have questions – I’m always available!
contact.textSecond: You can reach me via email or social media, or use the form on the right to send me a message directly. I try to respond as quickly as possible.
contact.textWait: Looking forward to hearing from you! 🚀

projects.githubFinder: An application that allows you to find a user by their username and display all their repositories. Uses the GitHub API to fetch data.
projects.skVerh: Corporate website for a construction company. Developed from scratch: implemented responsive layout, built a custom WordPress theme, integrated admin panel for easy content management.

about.text: Hi, I’m Vitali. Originally from a small village, now I’m living in the USA and making the web a better place one website at a time. I’ve been a frontend developer since 2019, focusing on clean, functional code and user-friendly designs. I’m passionate about building websites that not only look great but also work perfectly.
about.textFirst: I work with modern technologies like React, Vue, TypeScript, and Sass. I pay attention to performance, accessibility, and responsive design — because a good website should feel right on every screen.
about.textSec: For me, frontend is not just about code — it’s about solving problems and creating interfaces that make users' lives easier.
about.textThree: I enjoy working in teams, sharing knowledge, and keeping the workflow smooth and positive — no drama, just clean commits.
about.stackWP: Old tech? Maybe. Still awesome? Definitely. I use WordPress to build sites that feel anything but outdated. And no, I don’t install 47 plugins to make a button work.
about.outsideSubTitle: When I’m not writing code, I enjoy:
about.outsideItemOne: 🧭 Traveling – exploring new cities and cultures inspires my creative work.
about.outsideItemTwo: 📸 Photography – I love capturing moments that reflect the atmosphere of the places I visit.
about.outsideItemThree: 📚 Reading – I’m into fiction and self-growth books that fuel new perspectives and personal development.
about.outsideItemFour: 🎸 Music – I play the guitar to relax and stay balanced between work and life.
